title: Dreamworld Gold Coast 1 Day Ticket $55 (Valid for 14 Days from Date of Purchase) @ Dreamworld
body:
Deal: Dreamworld Gold Coast 1 Day Ticket $55 (Valid for 14 Days from Date of Purchase) @ Dreamworld

[PainToad] Remember to ride the roller coaster paid for by tax payers with money meant to save koalas. Scum bags. https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2022/jul/27/dream…
[AustriaBargain] There were so many mistakes made with that ride that even a curious bozo could have predicted and solved if they worked around it long enough. The missing slats, no procedure to stop the ride quickly over radio, no liquid sensor connected to the cutoff. They could have flown in experts running or designing the same ride overseas to inspect it and point these out. They just didn't care, running Disneyland was just another job to them.
[SnowDragon] Is Dreamworld worth it if you're not big into rides?
[dynaflow] Must be the middle of winter plus lousy weather….
[hodophile] Temu version of a Universal Studios no thanks
[eediot] Just been. For $55 it's a decent day out if you like rides. Not much to see otherwise, in terms of shows and exhibits. Beats the hour long queues at Movieworld. Ymmv.
[nephilim] Same I think most rides we had to wait about 20mins, some before closing had no queues like the cinema screen ride.
irony longest ride I think we waited was the really crappy Ferris wheel with my toddler, was like 30mins. Can tell they bought that ride on Alibaba for 5k
